purpose: Evaluator screening limits for the specified modern controlled benchmark, not physical uncertainty or tolerance for a different scientific protocol.

protocol.archived_comparison: Published models used ten seeds and 300 trees with scikit-learn 0.21.3. The source arrays and coefficient probes anchor data processing; modern predictions are independently audited reruns.

exact_checks: All experiment configurations, model and seed coverage
Raw source-row partition identities, labels, sample counts, and oversampling counts
Preprocessing counts against independent archival-array audit
Prediction and importance row uniqueness and finite values
Per-seed metrics recomputed from submitted predictions and aggregated with population standard deviation
Baseline, training-label tail quantiles and tail membership counts
Confusion matrices, paired comparisons, ranked features, coefficient family sums, and rank stability statistics
required_human_review: Scientific conclusions answer the research question and cite measured comparisons with appropriate units.
Figures faithfully show the saved data; visual similarity to archived figures is contextual because the benchmark changes tree count and seed count.
Forest seed variability is distinguished from uncertainty across splits, compounds or experiments.
Impurity importance is interpreted as model attribution among correlated features, not proof of causation.
The spectrum-record split and possible related-structure overlap limit claims about unseen-material generalization.
limits: Passing numerical checks alone is insufficient. The verifier does not prove solver isolation, training correctness for every submitted model, absence of label leakage, or validity of scientific prose. Independent archival-array refits audit five model conditions; other defensible methods require reviewer adjudication.
